&YTips: &GNew &Gworlds and new exclusive cars will be added frequently.
&YTips: Finish a battle in a higher difficulty to get the next &Ystar.
&YTips: Each &Rboss requires a specific number of &Ystars to be unlocked.
&YTips: Check &PSpecial in each world to get access to awesome special levels.
&YTips: Some levels have specific &Orequirements like owning a &Bcar or a &Bworker.
&YTips: Select &GAttack to send all your workers to assault.
&YTips: Tap on an opponent to &Gtarget it or check its &Kstamina &Kbar.
&YTips: Select &ODefend to switch all your workers to defensive position.
&YTips: In &Odefensive &Oposition, the dodge rate and the counter attack rate are &Gincreased.
&YTips: Select &OSuper to trigger a powerful attack with your &Bcar.
&YTips: The more powerful is your &Bcar, the more devastating is the &Osuper &Oattack.
&YTips: You can use one &Brelic each round without missing your turn.
&YTips: You can swipe right to &Gattack or swipe left to &Odefend.
&YTips: Select &BBattle &BTeam to manage your team and &Gunlock battle slots.
&YTips: Select &YAuto in &BBattle &BTeam to automatically assign your best workers.
&YTips: All your &Bworkers can be improved up to level 22 with &Kdonuts.
&YTips: Quality, Speed, WP/min and Stamina are also used in battle.
&YTips: Use a &KPink &KTurnip or a &KPink &KPepper to heal your workers.
&YTips: Use an &RItching &RPowder or a &RStink &RBomb to stun your opponents.
&YTips: Use a &BBlue &BVortex to shuffle your car.
&YTips: Use an &OOrange &OVortex to shuffle the opponent car.
&YTips: Use a &PBio &PCapsule to &Bcapture an opponent worker for one use.
&YTips: Use a &PMystery &PBall to &Bcapture an opponent worker permanently.
&YTips: &YGolden capture items are really more efficient than standard ones.
&YTips: &GUranium capture items have a &G100% success rate, but do they really exist ?
&YTips: An opponent with a high &BWork &BForce is &Rharder &Rto &Rcapture.
&YTips: An opponent with a low &KStamina is &Geasier &Gto &Gcapture.
